backgrounds.origin: Built-in ImageGen. Original artwork composed for the share-card canvas.
backgrounds.reference: User-supplied Lily perfume vial still and official white-lily illustration.
backgrounds.prompt: Image 1 is the current hand-painted 2:3 portrait share-card background, an edit target. Image 2 shows the exact perfume vial in Lily’s hand. Image 3 provides the flower shape. Redraw the botanical artwork as expressive theatrical anime illustration, matte gouache, broad lilac cel shadows, a few precise hand-inked lines, absolutely no photographic finish. Maintain anchors: large flower upper RIGHT, quiet center and upper-left for the header, a complete diagonal perfume vial at lower LEFT, painted rolling cloud bank in bottom RIGHT especially (x .52 to .98, y .76 to .89) which is subsequently cropped for the signature. Model the perfume vial closely on image 2: an elongated opalescent lavender glass cylinder, rounded base, silver filigree at bottom and collar, prominent butterfly/flower stopper at its top; barely 5:1 body aspect, highly readable as a perfume vial rather than a rod. In lower left quadrant let vial fill from x .05 to .42, y .72 to .95, a visible small curling plume as if scent is escaping. Design a small number of soft-edged curls with distinct layered brush shapes, keep mist lavender and visible. No text, characters, typography, logos, panels or additional accessories. White veil form: flowing folds of translucent ivory bridal voile visibly along right edge behind a graceful ivory lily with recurved pointed petals, pale yellow throat and golden stamens, based on the bouquet in image 3. A smaller flower accompanying perfume. Pearl pink and airy lilac ground, watercolor violet mist clearly visible among the bottom folds.
